about_the_game:
Welcome to Chirpvenience! is a short visual novel set in a small-town convenience store, offering a cozy and humorous slice-of-life experience.

Players take on a one-week part-time job in the tranquil “Lark Town”, working at the Chirpvenience store. Throughout the week, you’ll interact with quirky coworkers and customers, while stocking shelves, handling checkout, chatting, and facing unexpected events—discovering warmth, humor, and the everyday charm of small-town life.

Features

  • One-week part-time job: Immerse yourself in the cozy and whimsical daily life of a small town.

  • Character interactions: Engage with unique coworkers and customers, each with their own stories.

  • Multiple endings: The main story leads to a single “true ending,” while optional branches may end early or skip directly to the finale, offering different pacing.

  • Chirp-pedia: Collect everyday items to gradually unlock hidden town stories.

  • Relaxed experience: Simple controls and a soothing pace—perfect even for players who aren’t used to games.

  • Free to play with multilingual support: Currently supports Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese, with potential for more languages in the future.

Take it as a little vacation—step into Lark Town and enjoy a special week of working at Chirpvenience!
